ns2:section.sectionText: Career development and planning course for sociology majors. Teaches career-development theories; examines the competencies gained from the major; identifies marketable skills; and educates about campus resources for internship/job/career/grad school searches. Students will leave the course with a better understanding of the career decision-making process; the internship/job/grad school search process; and prepared to design their Illini experience for success.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Sociology major(s) or minor(s).
